title: Neon Knuckle Strut (Stage 1: Midnight Expressway)
style: Sega Mega Drive FM Synthwave / 90s Detroit Club Chiptune
key_signature: G Mixolydian / Dorian Hybrid (Funky, Cool, Non-Melancholic, Non-Heroic)

sound_chip_configuration.psg_chip: Texas Instruments SN76489 (3 Square Wave Channels + 1 Noise Channel)

channels.name: YM2612 Slap FM Bass
channels.description: Punchy, woody 4-op FM slap bass with crisp metallic attack (classic Koshiro bass).

channels.name: YM2612 House Piano / Brass Chords
channels.description: Syncopated 9th, 13th, and sus4 club chord stabs with stereo panning.

channels.name: YM2612 Synthwave Sync Lead
channels.description: Bright, edgy FM lead with slight pitch-bend swagger and portamento.

channels.name: YM2612 Warm FM Pad / Counter-Line
channels.description: Smooth chorused FM synthwave pad filling the mid-high frequencies.

channels.name: YM2612 8-Bit PCM Drums (Kick, Snare, Rim, Clap)
channels.description: Crunchy 8-bit sampled TR-909 kick & gated snare via Channel 6 DAC.

channels.name: SN76489 16th-Note Pulse Arpeggiator
channels.description: Driving synthwave octave/fifth arpeggio locked to the 16th-note grid.

channels.name: SN76489 White Noise Hi-Hats & Shaker
channels.description: Crisp 16th-note closed hats and off-beat open hi-hat sizzle.

sections.name: Intro - Neon Ignition
sections.lead_melody: Tacet (Arpeggiator & FM Chord Stabs build tension)

sections.name: Section A - Streets of Chrome (Main Groove)
Section C - Boss Rush Drop & Loop Point
sections.description: Full throttle drums with double-time DAC snare fills, high-octave FM lead, and loop back to Bar 5.
